newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 9.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Monday its performance in the first half of calendar 1996 was solid and its outlook was positive. It said second half sales would improve. Earlier Santos reported a half year net profit of A$88.6 million and set an 11.0 cents per share interim dividend.

Radio broadcaster Austereo Ltd said it is poised for further growth as its two main radio networks Triple M and Today Networks continue to win auidences. Austereo earlier reported a near doubling of net profit to A$36.46 million in the year to June 30, 1996, but A$12.8 million of that improvement came from the sale of its SEA FM Ltd stake.

The New South Wales government will later on Monday announce approval for the development of Newcrest Mining Ltd's Cadia Hill copper/gold project, New South Wales premier Bob Carr told Reuters. Newcrest said later on Monday it would not revise the dimensions or construction budget of its Cadia Mine following state government approval.

Westfield Holdings Ltd said late on Friday it would not no longer be a joint bidder with the AGA group for Australia's airports. Westfield said it proceed with an independent bid for the airports and would continue to participate in the bid programme.

The Seven Network is due to report its annual result around midday, and is expected to report a 25-30 percent higher pre-abnormal annual net profit of about A$114 million, but analysts say this rise was likely to have disguised a second half profit slowdown.
